 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. AMES, IA – It's brunch with the Bearcats as the University of Cincinnati kicks off at Jack Trice Stadium at 11 a.m. locally, noon in Cincinnati.
 Post bacon-and-eggs, UC hopes to pancake some Iowa State defenders at Jack Trice Stadium for that elusive sixth win and bowl eligibility. It would also be their first win in November since winning their first Big 12 game in Houston three years ago. They haven't won a road game since defeating Oklahoma State Oct. 18 of last season. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement After last week's one-score defeat at No. 17 Houston , UC is 1-12 in the 11th month of the year. The Bearcats are 5-4 (2-4 Big 12), with Iowa State's Cyclones coming in 4-5 (2-4 Big 12).
 Last season, UC defeated No. 14/No. 12 Iowa State at Nippert Stadium 38-30 in their best win of the season. 
 The Cyclones have 83 new players, including Arkansas State transfer quarterback Jaylen Raynor, another dual-threat weapon. Former walk-on Aiden Flora has terrorized defenses with 1,119 rushing yards.
 Flora has been over 100 yards four times and had 212 yards in shootout wins vs. West Virginia and 221 vs. then-No. 24 Oklahoma State. Arizona, Utah, BYU and Iowa have been the only teams to keep Flora below the century mark.
 Cincinnati Bearcats running back Cole Tabb scores on a 17-yard pass from JC French Nov. 7 at Houston. The Bearcats should have running back Cole Tabb back, who left the Houston game in the third quarter with a head injury . Tabb has 812 rushing yards and 14 total touchdowns to lead the Bearcats.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement UC should also have center Taran Tyo back on the offensive line, but will be without receiver JV Gibson, who left TDECU Stadium in Houston on a stretcher after sustaining a targeting hit in the end zone.
 Stream Cincinnati Bearcats at Iowa State 
 New updates will appear below, with the most recent at the top. 
 UC Bearcats healthy for most part vs. Iowa State
 11:17 AM ET, November 14 2026, Scott Springer 
 Only JV Gibson and Filip Maciorowski are listed as out. Taran Tyo, Cole Tabb, and Malachi Henry are all cleared in the game-day report.
 Also Cincinnati Bearcats football Chief of Staff says there should be no issue returning home after the FAA groundings yesterday. UC made it to Iowa ahead of the restrictions. The charter, crew and plane stay here until they depart later this afternoon.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It was 22 degrees this morning, but kickoff temperature looks like 41 degrees with wind just one mile per hour out of the south-southeast, according to the Weather Channel. On the field earlier, it was comfortable "football weather". The guys will be wearing different cleats today and there was dew on the Jack Trice Stadium grass.
 UC Bearcats punter Max Fletcher is Ray Guy Award semifinalist
 09:02 AM ET, November 14 2026, Scott Springer 
 Fletcher is one of 10 semifinalists for the 2026 Ray Guy Award. Fletcher has averaged 45.10 gross/43.43 net yards and has pinned opponents inside the 20-yard line 13 times. His career average is 45.3 yards per kick, second to former Cincinnati Bengal and UC James P. Kelly Athletic Hall of Famer Kevin Huber, who averaged 45.47.
